items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I bought him his first set.

ctx.x: We move out of the clowning, you know. Oh, we had a good band here. Who's, who's on bass there? Is that Frank Fields?

Oh, that's, he's holding the bass. Yeah, that's Frank Fields. Between you and the- That's the boy playing tenor with Fat Dinero now. That's where the hardest, that's Lou, that's the- The drummer or Paul? Oh, Paul, I'm drumming. He played with a studio band in California. Oh, yeah.

Oh, he's a drummer. He's a ranger too. I bought him his first set. Yeah. Drumming, he's a ranger too. That's right. That's right. He didn't like you to breed. He breed with you on there playing a show. You drumming? Oh, sure. No, I did though.
